Construct a crossform domain from a neuroim2 volume mask

Source: R/neuroim2-adapter.R
neuroim2_volume_domain.Rd

This conditional adapter records the mask's stable full-volume indices, physical coordinates, spacing, and full neuroim2 spatial metadata. It does not extract response data or import neuroim2 result types.

Usage

neuroim2_volume_domain(mask, id = "neuroim2-volume")

Arguments

mask

A three-dimensional neuroim2 NeuroVol mask.

id

Stable domain identity.

Value

An effect_domain with $kind "volume", $feature_ids giving the mask's full-volume indices, $coordinates in millimeters, and $metadata carrying dim, spacing, voxel indices, the logical mask, and a neuroim2_space_sha256 hash of the full neuroim2 space.

See also

volume_domain() for the same object from a plain array, neuroim2_searchlights() for matching neighborhoods, and as_neurovol() to write compact results back out.

Other neural domains and frames: abstract_domain(), additive_frame(), as_neurovol(), compile_frame(), edge_frame(), frame_conservation(), frame_family(), measurement_frame(), neuroim2_searchlights(), regions(), searchlights(), volume_domain(), voxelwise(), whole_brain()

Examples

if (requireNamespace("neuroim2", quietly = TRUE) &&
    utils::packageVersion("neuroim2") >= "0.19.0") {
  values <- array(FALSE, c(5L, 5L, 4L))
  values[2:4, 2:4, 2:3] <- TRUE
  mask <- neuroim2::LogicalNeuroVol(
    values, neuroim2::NeuroSpace(c(5L, 5L, 4L), spacing = c(3, 3, 3))
  )
  domain <- neuroim2_volume_domain(mask, id = "subject-mask")

  # Compact features, addressed by their stable full-volume indices, so a
  # result vector can always be placed back in the original array.
  print(domain$n_features)
  print(identical(domain$feature_ids, which(values)))

  # Physical spacing and a hash of the full neuroim2 space are recorded;
  # any frame built later must agree with that geometry.
  print(domain$metadata$spacing)
  print(substr(domain$metadata$neuroim2_space_sha256, 1, 24))
}
#> [1] 18
#> [1] TRUE
#> [1] 3 3 3
#> [1] "sha256:ea44fad00b51f3d39"
